expected_answer: 25 paid days per calendar year, plus England and Wales bank holidays.

question: I have an approved hybrid arrangement. Can I claim my normal train fare for required office days?
expected_answer: No. Hybrid working normally requires at least 2 office days a week; normal commuting is not reimbursed, including required hybrid office days.

relevant_passages.heading: Office attendance
relevant_passages.exact_text: The standard arrangement is at least 2 office days per working week, agreed with your line manager. Employees working fewer than 5 days per week agree an attendance pattern individually; this policy gives no automatic pro-rata formula. Team meetings may require attendance on a specified day.

Normal home-to-office commuting is not reimbursed, including the office days required by the remote working policy. Taxis require advance line-manager approval unless there is an immediate safety concern; explain any exception in the claim.

question: I am ill during approved annual leave. How do I report it and get those days back?
expected_answer: Report by 10:00 on the first affected working day to your manager; if unavailable email People. Self-certify up to 7 calendar days; a fit note is needed for longer absence. People reviews reclassification; restoration is not automatic.

relevant_passages.heading: Illness during leave
relevant_passages.exact_text: If you become ill during approved annual leave, notify your line manager by 10:00 on the first affected working day and follow the sickness reporting policy. The People team reviews requests to reclassify affected days. Reclassification is not automatic.

relevant_passages.heading: Reporting
relevant_passages.exact_text: If you cannot work because of illness, telephone your line manager by 10:00 on the first affected working day. If they are unavailable, email people@northstar-demo.example by the same deadline. Tell them your likely absence duration if known; you do not need to disclose your diagnosis to colleagues.

relevant_passages.heading: Evidence
relevant_passages.exact_text: Self-certify absences of up to 7 consecutive calendar days in PeopleHub. For more than 7 consecutive calendar days, provide a fit note covering the absence. Weekends count when determining whether a fit note is required.

relevant_passages.heading: Illness on holiday
relevant_passages.exact_text: For illness during approved annual leave, use the same first-day reporting deadline and evidence rules. The People team reviews reclassification of annual leave; see the annual leave policy. This document does not guarantee that every affected day will be restored.
